items.html: And after that, at the time of nursing, his VAK extend further, and also the three Mochin in him awaken somewhat, so as to give him understanding of the things he necessarily needs — to cry when he is not nursing, and to ask his mother, through his crying and his signals, for what he needs. And so he goes on growing from degree to degree, but his intellect is still sealed and there is no revelation of Daat in him.
